mapper.sql: SELECT pp.id,pp.contract_id,k.number AS contract_number,c.name AS customer_name,pp.position,pp.name,pp.amount,pp.due_on, COALESCE(SUM(r.amount),0) AS paid, CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(r.amount),0)=pp.amount THEN 'PAID' WHEN pp.due_on < #{today} AND k.status IN ('SIGNED','COMPLETED') THEN 'OVERDUE' WHEN COALESCE(SUM(r.amount),0)>0 THEN 'PARTIAL' ELSE 'UNPAID' END AS status FROM sales_payment_plan pp JOIN sales_contract k ON k.organization_id=pp.organization_id AND k.id=pp.contract_id JOIN sales_quote q ON q.organization_id=k.organization_id AND q.id=k.quote_id LEFT JOIN sales_receipt r ON r.organization_id=pp.organization_id AND r.plan_id=pp.id WHERE
